You don't have to be ruthless to anyone else. Only to yourself.

Kevin explains that mega-successful people like Ray Kroc were ruthless in business, but you don't have to be like that.

What he asks is to be ruthless with yourself: your persistence, your personal development and your attitude. Keep sharpening the axe so your attitude works when you need it.

Where in your life do you need to be tougher on yourself?
